column1: # tests/spinel-mlir/tests.tsv -- every test of spinel-mlir's consumer
# (tools/spinel-mlir), under one class, so tests/spinel-mlir/run.sh can run
# the routine ones and refuse to run with a test it does not know.
#   kind     ctest (an add_test of tools/spinel-mlir/CMakeLists.txt) or lit
#            (a test/*.test file, its RUN lines read by run.sh)
#   test     the ctest name, or the .test file's stem
#            oracle-records  compares with the Go frontend's output that
#                            oracle); those records were not imported
#            oracle-committed  compares with the Go frontend's output committed
#            confirm         hand-written expectations whose source is the Go
#                            frontend's output: oracles, as the owner named them
#            absent          needs an archived facts supply under spinel-mlir's
# The classes come from the first run (2026-10-26): each failing test's
# cause, read from its output; the note names the record it read.
